arStrings.szText: Your {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skills create a {c_important}Decoy Trap{/c} that Taunts and lures enemies, dealing {c_random}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix_Value_1]{/c} Corrupting damage over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. This counts as a {c_important}Trap{/c} Skill and only one {c_important}Decoy{/c} can be active at a time.
